heading: RoadLane
text: A RoadLane is a type of TravelledWayLane that forms part of a RoadSegment.

heading: ScheduledCode
text: The operational status of an entity, e.g., open or closed.

heading: FootpathLink
text: A Footpath Link is a type of TravelledWayLink designed for pedestrians.

heading: TravelledWayLane
text: A TravelledWayLane is a NetworkElement that is a portion of TravelledWaySegment intended to accommodate a single line of moving material entities (e.g., vehicles) along its length.

heading: PublicTransportSystemThing
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify classes defined in the Public Transport System Pattern ontology.

heading: RoadLinkUserType
text: A RoadLinkUserType represents the unique combination of a RoadLink and a UserType such that speed limits and other characteristics can be defined to apply to specific user types when operating along a particular road link.

heading: RoadSection
text: A RoadSection is a type of TravelledWaySection that groups RoadLinks and RoadSegments for a useful operational purpose (e.g., assigning a speed limit, designating a traffic control scheme).

heading: GroupOfLines
text: A GroupOfLines is a logical grouping of PublicTransportLines for any useful purpose.

heading: MicromobilityPathSegment
text: A MicromobilityPathSegment can be defined to be a part of a MicromobilityPathSection, especially when the MicromobilityPathSection does not span an entire MicromobilityLink.

heading: TransportAlert
text: A TransportAlert is a type of alert that can be used to notify people of important transport information.

heading: PublicTransportSystem
text: A PublicTransportSystem provides transport services to members of the public.

heading: TravelledWaySegment
text: A TravelledWaySegment is a type of a transinfras:TravelledWaySegment and NetworkElement that represents a contiguous length of a TravelledWayLink characterized by the same physical characteristics.

heading: MicromobilityPathSection
text: A MicromobilityPathSections is a type of RoadSection that groups MicromobilityLinks and MicromobilityPathSegments for a useful operational purpose (e.g., assigning a speed limit, designating areas of shared use).

heading: FootpathNetwork
text: A FootpathNetwork is a type of TransportNetwork designed for the use of pedestrians but may be used by others as well.

heading: PointOnRoute
text: A PointOnRoute represents an ordered RoutePoint for a PublicTransportRoute.

heading: TrackLink
text: Due to the nature of rail, each TrackLink consists of a single lane, but multiple TrackLinks can exist along the same RailCorridor.

heading: RailSection
text: A RailSection is a type of TravelledWaySection that groups TrackLinks and TrackSegments for a useful operational purpose (e.g., assigning a speed limit, designating a traffic control scheme).

heading: TransportNetwork
text: A TransportNetwork is a NetworkElement that is a collection of other network elements that jointly represent a network of paths along which entities (e.g., vehicles, pedestrians) of a specified mode can operate.

heading: MicromobilityLink
text: A MicromobilityLink is a type of RoadLink designed for micromobility vehicles.

heading: MicromobilityPath
text: A MicromobilityPath is a type of Road that is made up of MicromobilityPathLinks.

heading: NetworkElement
text: A NetworkElement represents any element of a transport network. It can be a part of another NetworkElement and can be decomposed into smaller NetworkElements.

heading: RoutePoint
text: A RoutePoint represents a point of interest along a PublicTransportRoute.

heading: TravelledWay
text: A TravelledWay is a type of NetworkElement and transinfras:TravelledWay that represents the curvilinear length of a transport route that is identified by a specific designator.

heading: TravelledWayLink
text: A TravelledWayLink is a type of NetworkElement and transinfras:TravelledWayLink. It represents a contiguous length of a TravelledWay between two TransportNodes of operational or managerial significance.

heading: FootpathLane
text: A FootpathLane is a type of TravelledWayLane that forms part of a FootpathSegment.

heading: FootpathSection
text: A FootpathSection is a type of TravelledWaySection that groups FootpathLinks and FootpathSegments for a useful operational purpose.

heading: MicromobilityLane
text: A MicromobilityLane is a type of RoadLane that forms part of a MicromobilityPathSegment.

heading: MicromobilityNetwork
text: A MicromobilityNetwork is a type of RoadNetwork designed for the use of micromobility vehicles, which have more limited performance characteristics than motor vehicles.

heading: Road
text: A Road is a type of TravelledWay and cdm2:Road that is made up of RoadLinks. Roads form a proper part of RoadNetworks.

heading: TrackSegment
text: A TrackSegment is a type of TravelledWaySegment that represents a portion of a TrackLink with common physical characteristics.

heading: FootpathSegment
text: A FootpathSegment can be defined to be a part of a FootpathSection, especially when the FootpathSection does not span an entire FootpathLink.

heading: TravelCorridorLink
text: A TravelCorridorLink is a type of TravelledWayLink that is made up of TravelCorridorSegments.

heading: Footpath
text: A Footpath is a type of TravelledWay that is made up of FootpathLinks.

heading: VehicleFlowRate
text: A flow rate measured in vehicles per unit time.

heading: TransportAlertThing
text: The transport alert pattern addresses the need for public agencies to alert groups to unusual transport-related conditions. Most of the features of the transport alert pattern can also be used for other types of alerts (e.g., meteorological events) and as such, its design includes the definition of a generalized alert.

heading: RailCorridor
text: A RailCorridor is a type of TravelledWay that is made up of TrackLinks.

heading: RoadSegment
text: A RoadSegment can be defined to be a part of a RoadSection, for example, when the RoadSection does not span an entire RoadLink.

heading: TransportNetworkThing
text: The Transport Network Pattern models the core concepts involved in describing a transport network. This includes an identification of both physical and administrative characteristics. heading: PublicTransportRoute
text: A PublicTransportRoute represents one specific path used by a public transport vehicle to transport passengers to and from designated locations.

heading: RailNetwork
text: A RailNetwork is a type of TransportNetwork using rails on a stabilized base.

heading: TransportNode
text: A TransportNode is a NetworkElement that represents a node on the transport network that can be used to designate an end to a link or to join links.

heading: Junction
text: A Junction is a TransportNode that allows a traveller to connect from one TravelledWayLink to another.

heading: TravelledWaySection
text: A TravelledWaySection is a type of NetworkElement that represents an aggregation of TravelledWayLinks and TravelledWaySegments that jointly represent a contiguous length of a path that shares the same management and operational strategies (within the scope of interest of the implementation).

heading: PublicTransportElement
text: A PublicTransportElement represents any element of a public transport system. It can be a part of another PublicTransportElement and can be decomposed into smaller PublicTransportElement.

heading: PublicTransportLine
text: A PublicTransportLine is one or more routes used by public transport vehicles to transport passengers to and from designated locations.

heading: RoadLink
text: A RoadLink is a type of TravelledWayLink and cdm2:RoadLink using a stabilized base designed for the movement of vehicles that conform to a specified set of requirements but may be used by others as well.

heading: TravelCorridor
text: A TravelCorridor is a type of TravelledWay that is made up of TravelCorridorLinks.

heading: TravelCorridorSegment
text: A TravelCorridorSegment is a type of TravelledWaySegment that logically groups multiple TravelledWaySegments together as being co-located or side-by-side.

heading: RoadNetwork
text: Roads are most commonly associated with motor vehicles, but can be designed for other types of vehicles (e.g., micromobility vehicles).

heading: TravelCorridorObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Travel Corridor Pattern.

heading: TravelCorridorThing
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all classes defined in the Travel Corridor Pattern.

heading: corridorElement
text: An NetworkElement that is considered to be part of the larger transport corridor.

heading: ITSObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined for the transport service of the City Data Model.

heading: RoadNetworkObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Road Network Pattern.

heading: capacity
text: The rated capacity of the object.

heading: next
text: The next sequential object in a series.

heading: pavementType
text: Code indicating the type of material used for the surfacing of the roadway.

heading: previous
text: The previous sequential object in a series.

heading: primaryUser
text: A code indicating the type of user for which the described object was primarily designed. Other users may be allowed.

heading: speedLimit
text: The maximum legal speed.

heading: travelTime
text: The time to travel the length of the object.

heading: usedBy
text: The categories of users that use the RoadLink

heading: userCategory
text: A code indicating the type of user.

heading: uses
text: The RoadLink a user category is associated with.

heading: width
text: The width of the object.

heading: PublicTransportSystemObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Public Transport System Pattern.

heading: direction
text: A code representing the direction of operation.

heading: routePoint
text: A TransportNode that represents a point of interest along a PublicTransportRoute.

heading: routePointType
text: An indication of the type of route point.

heading: routePoints
text: An ordered series of route points along a PublicTransportRoute.

heading: TransportAlertObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Transport Alert Pattern.

heading: affects
text: The NetworkElements affected by the effect

heading: TransportNetworkObjectProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Transport Network Pattern.

heading: allowedDirections
text: A code list indicating the allowed directions for a particular line.

heading: egress
text: An exit link from a node.

heading: from
text: the starting node of a link.

heading: ingress
text: An entry link to a node.

heading: status
text: The operational status.

heading: timeInterval
text: The time interval during which the code applies.

heading: to
text: The end node of a link.

heading: travelCorridorSegment
text: TravelCorridorSegments to which this TravelledWaySegment is associated.

heading: ITSDataProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all data properties defined for the transport service of the City Data Model.

heading: RoadNetworkDataProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all data properties defined in the Road Network Pattern.

heading: maxLanes
text: The maximum number of lanes available for the RoadLink within any RoadSegment within the RoadLink.

heading: numLanes
text: The number of lanes within the RoadSegment.

heading: PublicTransportSystemDataProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all data properties defined in the Public Transport System Pattern.

heading: index
text: integer value that indicates the order of the item in a list

heading: isBorderCrossing
text: A boolean value that indicates whether the node serves as a border crossing.

heading: isViaPoint
text: A boolean value that indicates whether the node is referenced as a part-way point on a route.

heading: TransportNetworkDataProperty
text: Added for organizational purposes, to identify all data properties defined in the Transport Network Pattern.

heading: designator
text: A name assigned to the object.
